contract_findings: The pass contains axes only: head cross-axis, shoulder axis, pelvis axis, two arm chains, two leg chains and prop extent/breadth. No mass contour, limb thickness, hand/foot block, joint anatomy or clothing entered P2.
drawing_findings: The pelvis_legs crop shows the P2 braced-leg axis and the inherited P1 counterbalance flow running as two separated near-parallel lines down the thigh, which reads as a pant-leg contour rail: the specific anti-pattern the P2 reference forbids.
The rail is not a P2 authoring error. The subject-derived P2 axis is correct; the inherited P1 counterbalance flow sits roughly 9 canvas pixels too far image-right through the upper thigh.
Moving the P2 axis onto the P1 flow would be compensating downstream for a wrong upstream line, so the earliest-responsible-stage rule applies and P1 must be reopened instead.
Head cross-axis, shoulder axis, pelvis axis, both arm chains and the support-leg chain all agree with the subject and need no change.
